changes_applied.description: Applied all pending migrations 001–005 to a fresh bilimbaga-db instance. Migration 005_rbac.up.sql created the permissions and role_permissions tables, renamed the hr_admin role to examiner, and seeded the full RBAC permission matrix.

Created .env from .env.example so Docker Compose could resolve DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD variables. The .env file uses placeholder values from .env.example (password: changeme) suitable for local development only.

env_vars_added.name: DB_PASSWORD
env_vars_added.description: Currently set to placeholder 'changeme' from .env.example. Must be changed to a strong secret for any non-local environment.

env_vars_added.name: JWT_SECRET
env_vars_added.description: Currently set to placeholder 'replace-with-at-least-32-random-chars'. Must be replaced with a securely generated value.

user_instructions: For local development the defaults in .env are sufficient. Before any staging/production deployment, replace DB_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET in .env with strong, randomly generated values — never commit the .env file.
